description: Selective evaluation corpus for the memory delivery (spec `memory`, ticket command-center#74). Derived from the operator's real Claude memory corpus for command-center: each note is a representative real lesson with its hook compressed from the live index. Lane agents seed these notes through ordinary `cctl memory create`/`link` calls; they never read the operator's home directory. The ten named queries define the recall acceptance targets (spec R7.1); the stale-status specimen drives the withholding scenario (spec R2.1). Filler notes to exceed the index budget may be generated procedurally at evaluation time and are not part of this fixture's contract.

notes.hook: The feature is named Notepad, never Notebook; slices 1-2 merged, slice 3 capture spec revision 8 signed off
notes.body: The right-pane working-document feature is called Notepad. The term Notebook is wrong and was explicitly corrected. Slices 1 and 2 are merged (address their code by path, not by session SHAs - the work merged squashed). Slice 3 covers clips and voice capture.

notes.hook: Zero test failures plus 'Timeout calling onTaskUpdate' means swap thrash, not a branch defect
notes.body: A vitest run that reports no test failures but dies with Timeout calling "onTaskUpdate" (or a single lone test timeout) is memory pressure, not a real failure. Check sysctl vm.swapusage and re-run the file in isolation before hunting a branch defect.

notes.hook: A scoped test run passes with zero matching files - a mistyped path still exits 0; read the verdict line or pass --require-match
notes.body: cctl validate run test with a path filter exits 0 when no files match, so a typo silently produces a vacuous pass. The verdict line names the matched-file count. Use --require-match to make an empty match exit 1. Separately, --wait can exit 0 with no verdict at all: always read the verdict, or use --json.

notes.hook: Layered Tailwind utilities never beat unlayered legacy CSS regardless of specificity - measure in the live browser
notes.body: Utilities in the Tailwind layer lose to any unlayered legacy rule; specificity is irrelevant because layer order decides. min-h-full lost to a .ProseMirror rule, and jsdom could not observe the difference - only a live browser measurement showed it.

notes.hook: The docked stage's CSS transform becomes the containing block for every position:fixed descendant in the right pane - portal to body
notes.body: A transform on .conversation-docked-stage silently makes it the containing block for all position: fixed descendants, offsetting them by roughly +340,+157. Anything that must be viewport-fixed from the right pane has to portal to document.body, as DocumentCommentCard already does.

notes.hook: cctl --json piped through jq truncates at 64KB - redirect to a file first
notes.body: Piping cctl --json output straight into jq truncates the stream at 64KB and the parse fails or silently loses rows. Redirect to a file, then read the file.

notes.hook: A raw NUL byte makes a .ts file read as binary so plain grep silently misses matches - use grep -a
notes.body: Write/Edit tooling decodes unicode escapes to raw bytes; a raw NUL landing in a source file makes grep treat it as binary and report nothing. Auto-merge once hid conflict markers this way. grep -a sees through it. Patch such files via a bun script instead of raw editor writes.

notes.hook: Backticks inside double-quoted cctl arguments run shell substitution and blank the text - use single quotes or files
notes.body: A double-quoted cctl argument containing backticks gets command-substituted by the shell before cctl sees it, producing empty or mangled text. Use single quotes or file-backed flags for any prose that may contain backticks.

notes.hook: An unpruned .next/cache/turbopack (8.4GB) made next build ~59x slower, stuck at 99% CPU on one core - prune the cache
notes.body: The Turbopack filesystem cache fixed the memory balloon and then became the bug: at 8.4GB the build took 1797s versus 128s at 1.5GB. The signature is next build pinned at 99% CPU on one of sixteen cores. Prune the cache directory.

notes.hook: Migration 0013's test base64-encodes the absolute path, so long worktree names fail with ENAMETOOLONG - not a bug
notes.body: A very long session or worktree name makes the migration-0013 test fail with ENAMETOOLONG because it base64-encodes the absolute path into a filename. Shorten the worktree name; the migration itself is fine.

notes.hook: ps -E flattens the environment on darwin - use KERN_PROCARGS2 to read another process's env
notes.body: Reading a process's environment with ps -E on macOS flattens and truncates it. The reliable read is the KERN_PROCARGS2 sysctl. Also from the same work: the vitest duration cache reorders test files on the second run.

notes.hook: Bare grid-cols-[1fr] blows out on mobile - use minmax(0,1fr)
notes.body: A bare 1fr grid column lets long content expand the track past the viewport on mobile. minmax(0,1fr) is the correct spelling.

notes.hook: A readConfig() page without force-dynamic prerenders at build time against the live config.json
notes.body: Next.js prerenders pages that call readConfig() unless they declare force-dynamic, baking build-machine config into the page. Declare the route dynamic when it reads live configuration.

notes.hook: Request Changes and withdraw-proposal mint a NEW revision id and retire old asks - approval carry survives, ask identity never replays
notes.body: A reopened spec draft is a new revision: revision-scoped approval-request identity never replays, while approvals on unchanged subjects carry. Conflating the two caused a plan_defect halt on ticket 87.

notes.hook: Cursor darwin support derives the SDK package from runtime platform+arch; the evidenced-host matrix was removed the day after merge
notes.body: Ticket 88 merged an evidenced-host gating matrix and the very next commit removed it, deriving the SDK package from platform+arch instead. None of the matrix vocabulary exists in src/ anymore - a memory recorded the old design as current and would have sent a reader hunting for symbols that no longer exist.

link.note: The withholding specimen. Its statusNote is deliberately false, and the evaluation lets the status lease lapse and expects the statusNote withheld while the lesson body above stays delivered (spec R2.1). The about link is an ordinary typed link to the ticket the note is about (spec R8).
